messages.author: 0bfa20c477b075c7
messages.subject: Interactive Plots
parts:
Ian,

I'm getting the following error message when I try to use the
interactive plot in Deducer. The plot templates work fine, just when
I try to use the interactive function, this message pops up, and the
window to assign variables/data does not appear.


>Error in .jcall("RJavaTools", "Z", "hasField", .jcast(x, "java/lang/Object"), :
java.lang.NullPointerException


Running deducer 4.2, JGR 1.7.4 on OS X, 10.5.8 on PPC. Any ideas..?

Thanks.

Ben B.

messages.author: 267c7c6c510dc8a2
messages.subject: Re: Interactive Plots
parts:
Ben,

I can't tell much from your e-mail. what do you get from sessionInfo()

Make sure the packages rJava, JGR, Deducer, JavaGD, iplots are up to date with

install.packages("<package name>",type="source")

Ian

Note to everyone: When reporting a bug or problem, please make sure
your packages are up-to-date, and include the result of sessionInfo(),
and if possible a reproducible example.
